title: Upper
author: Keane M.
desc: Unleash your upper body potential with the Push program, designed for focused strength development over one intense week. This single-day workout targets your chest, shoulders, and triceps through a series of effective machine and dumbbell exercises, including the Abs Crunch, Lateral Raise, and Tricep Rope Push Down. With a well-structured blend of sets and reps, you’ll build muscle while enhancing your overall upper body strength. Get ready to push your limits and see results!
